description: Runs a StateAlchemist machine for the lifetime of a .NET Generic Host: started with the host, fed from a channel, stopped on shutdown.
Benign dependency-confusion proof-of-concept package. It contains no executable code, installation scripts, build targets, or runtime behavior.

Pure C# .NET 10 in-process GraphRAG engine. Unifies dense SIMD vector search (Glacier.Vector) and zero-allocation CSR knowledge graph traversal (Glacier.Graph) directly with native LLM inference (Glacier.Inference) in a single memory space. Replaces Python LangChain, LlamaIndex, Chroma, and Neo4j.
An embeddable F# database with a MySQL-compatible SQL engine and wire protocol.

Opinionated Cosmos DB persistence primitives: partition-scoped contexts, transactional batches, audit stamping, soft delete, point-read sets, a Newtonsoft serializer, local-emulator support, and ETag-fenced partition locks.
Extracts device facts and Portal-ready config schemas from a PepperDash Essentials plugin repo, from its source and built assemblies, without running plugin code.
Keeps a PepperDash Essentials plugin README in sync with its code: .NET and Essentials badges, and the generated plugin documentation sections.
